_comment: Join CTA copy keyed by score band. {suburb}, {score}, {membershipStandard}, {membershipConcession}, {weeklyFares} are replaced at render. Voice rules apply: plain, specific, sourced, no em-dashes, no negate-then-correct constructions.

stranded.heading: CAR OWNERSHIP IS COMPULSORY HERE
stranded.body: {suburb} scored {score}/100 because successive state governments chose to ignore it. Fusion costed the fix. Membership is {membershipStandard} a year, or {membershipConcession} on the concession rate.

poor.heading: FULL FARE FOR A FRACTION OF THE SERVICE
poor.body: A week of metro commuting costs about {weeklyFares}. {suburb} receives {score}/100 service in return. Fusion membership is {membershipStandard} a year ({membershipConcession} concession) and includes a costed transport plan.
poor.bodyRegional: {suburb} receives {score}/100 service, and regional fares run higher than the metro myki cap. Fusion membership is {membershipStandard} a year ({membershipConcession} concession) and includes a costed transport plan.

patchy.heading: PATCHY SERVICE RUNS BY CHANCE, NOT CHOICE
patchy.body: {suburb} scores only {score}/100. We costed the plan to bring high-frequency transit to your address. Join Fusion for {membershipStandard} a year ({membershipConcession} concession) to make it happen.

decent.heading: DECENT BUT NOT COMPLETE
decent.body: {suburb} scores {score}/100. While this is better than most of Melbourne, service still drops off at night and on weekends. Join Fusion for {membershipStandard} a year ({membershipConcession} concession) to fund the campaign for a complete timetable.

good.heading: THE STANDARD EVERY SUBURB DESERVES
good.body: {suburb} scores {score}/100, proving that high-quality public transport is possible. Join Fusion for {membershipStandard} a year ({membershipConcession} concession) to campaign for this standard across Victoria.
